audit_context.title: Comprehensive UI/UX Audit Prompt for Admin Section
audit_context.scope: Admin dashboard, modals, forms, and all user-facing interfaces
audit_context.purpose: Identify and document all low-quality UI/UX elements, inconsistencies, and areas needing improvement

visual_hierarchy.description: Assess visual hierarchy, spacing, and layout quality
checks: Are form sections visually separated with proper spacing?
Do related fields have visual grouping (borders, backgrounds, spacing)?
Is there clear visual hierarchy between primary and secondary actions?
Are form fields properly spaced (not cramped, not too loose)?
Do modals have proper padding and breathing room?
Are labels clearly associated with inputs (spacing, typography)?
Is there visual distinction between required and optional fields?
Do error states have proper visual treatment?
red_flags: Forms using only space-y-4 without visual grouping
Color pickers using basic HTML input[type='color']
No visual separation between form sections
Buttons cramped at bottom without proper spacing
Labels too close or too far from inputs
No visual indication of required fields

checks: Is the modal properly centered and sized?
Does the modal have proper backdrop/overlay?
Is the close button clearly visible and accessible?
Are form fields in modals properly spaced?
Do modals have proper max-height with scrolling?
Is the modal title and description clear?
Are action buttons properly positioned and styled?
Does the modal have proper focus management?
Is there proper visual feedback on form submission?
red_flags: Forms in modals with no visual grouping
Color inputs using basic HTML color picker
No loading states on submit buttons
Buttons at bottom without proper spacing/padding
Modal content too cramped or too spread out
No visual separation between form sections in modals

form_design.description: Assess form input design and layout
checks: Are inputs properly styled with consistent borders and focus states?
Do date inputs have proper calendar icons or date pickers?
Are select dropdowns properly styled and functional?
Do textareas have proper sizing and resize handling?
Are color pickers custom-designed or using basic HTML input?
Do number inputs have proper step and validation?
Are file uploads properly styled with drag-and-drop?
Is there proper error handling and display?
Are placeholders helpful and not redundant with labels?
red_flags: Date inputs without calendar icons or date pickers
No visual feedback on validation errors
File inputs using basic HTML file input

checks: Are buttons properly sized and have adequate padding?
Do buttons have proper hover and active states?
Are primary and secondary actions clearly distinguished?
Are buttons properly spaced from each other?
Do buttons have loading states?
Are destructive actions (delete) properly styled?
Are button groups properly aligned?
Do buttons have proper disabled states?
red_flags: Buttons too small or too large
No loading states on async actions

checks: Is spacing consistent between similar components?
Are page sections properly spaced?
Do cards have consistent padding?
Are table rows properly spaced?
Is there proper spacing between form groups?
Are modals properly padded?
Do stats cards have consistent spacing?
Is there proper margin between major sections?
red_flags: Table rows too cramped or too spaced

color_and_visual_elements.description: Assess color usage and visual elements
checks: Are colors used consistently across admin?
Do status indicators use appropriate colors?
Are color pickers custom-designed?
Is there proper contrast for accessibility?
Do icons have consistent sizing and spacing?
Are badges and tags properly styled?
Is there visual feedback for interactive elements?
Are loading states properly styled?
red_flags: Basic HTML color input (ugly default styling)

checks: Is there clear typography hierarchy?
Are labels properly sized and weighted?
Is text readable with proper line height?
Are headings properly sized and spaced?
Is there consistent font sizing across forms?
Are error messages properly styled?
Is help text properly styled and positioned?
red_flags: Labels too small or too large
Text too cramped or too loose

checks: Do forms provide proper validation feedback?
Are loading states clear and informative?
Is there proper error handling and display?
Do modals close properly on backdrop click?
Is there proper focus management?
Are tooltips used where helpful?
Is there confirmation for destructive actions?
Are success messages properly displayed?
Do modals work properly on mobile?
Are forms usable on small screens?
Do tables have proper mobile handling?
Are buttons properly sized for touch?
Is spacing appropriate for mobile?
Do grids collapse properly?
Is text readable on mobile?
Do inputs have proper labels?
Are required fields properly marked?
Is there proper ARIA labeling?
Is keyboard navigation supported?
Is focus visible?
Are error messages associated with inputs?
Is color not the only indicator?
Is contrast sufficient?

forms: Edit pages for rooms, add-ons, gallery, clients

issues: Basic HTML color input (type='color') looks terrible
No visual grouping of related fields
Form uses only space-y-4 without sections
No visual separation between form groups
Buttons at bottom without proper spacing
Modal title could be more descriptive

form_sections.example: Use bordered sections, background colors, or dividers to group related fields
form_sections.implementation: Wrap related fields in <div className='border rounded-lg p-4 space-y-4'>

color_picker.example: Use a custom color picker component with swatches and hex input
color_picker.implementation: Create ColorPicker component with visual swatches

date_inputs.example: Add calendar icons, use date picker library, or custom calendar component
date_inputs.implementation: Use react-day-picker or similar with proper styling

form_spacing.example: Use space-y-6 for form sections, space-y-4 for fields within sections
form_spacing.implementation: Apply consistent spacing scale: space-y-6 between sections, space-y-4 within sections

button_groups.example: Add proper padding, use DialogFooter component, ensure proper spacing
button_groups.implementation: Use DialogFooter with gap-2 or gap-3, add pt-6 before buttons

visual_hierarchy.example: Use section headers, dividers, background colors, or borders
visual_hierarchy.implementation: Add h3 headers for sections, use border-t dividers, subtle bg-gray-50 for sections

issues.type: visual_hierarchy | modal_quality | form_design | spacing | color | typography | interaction | responsive | accessibility

forms: Check all form inputs for proper styling

Check form field spacing (should be space-y-4 or space-y-6)

critical: Replace all basic HTML color inputs with custom color pickers
Fix form spacing and visual hierarchy in all modals

Add loading states to all async actions
high: Enhance date inputs with calendar icons
medium: Add confirmation dialogs for destructive actions
